subject: Middlebury Sophomore, Hungry to Learn
body:
Hi Jon,

I'm Max, 20, ambitious, curious about entrepreneurship, and a current Midd kid. Brewing at Otter Creek before law school, then leaving law for consulting and consulting for investing, is a career of trading earned credentials away on purpose.

I've been building an AI teaching assistant for Middlebury, so I'm hungry to learn and would love to know which of those detours actually changed how you read a founder, and which one you would not repeat. If you're open to 10 minutes, I promise I'll pay it forward.

Best,
Max

subject: 20 Year Old Building an AI Teaching Assistant
body:
Hi Guillermo,

I'm Max, a Middlebury sophomore. I built an AI teaching assistant for our STEM courses, won $5K at MiddChallenge for it, and I'm partway through Entrepreneur First interviews.

Teaching yourself English to read programming docs, then building Next.js, closed a loop: the thing you had to translate to learn is now what others learn on.

I'm heading to Buenos Aires next fall to study at UBA, and what I want to know is what actually taught you, given nobody was teaching.

If you're open to 10 minutes, I promise I'll pay it forward.

Best,
Max
